fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The modo-bugs update script had no checks to flag issues that had been assigned more than one category label, or issues whose titles were excessively long. Both conditions indicate data quality problems that need manual attention.

## What changed

Added two new functions in `modo_bugs/update.py`, following the same pattern as the existing `check_for_invalid_card_names`:

- `check_for_multiple_categories(issue, categories)`: applies the `Multiple Categories` label when an issue has more than one category label, removes it otherwise.
- `check_for_long_title(issue)`: applies the `Title Too Long` label when `len(issue.title) > 100`, removes it otherwise.

Both are called from `process_issue` immediately after the `categories` list is computed (line 116), so they run on every open issue during the sweep.

**Note:** The `Multiple Categories` and `Title Too Long` labels must be created manually in the PennyDreadfulMTG/modo-bugs GitHub repository before this script runs, otherwise `add_to_labels` will raise an error.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks). No unit tests exist for this module, so none were added or broken.

Fixes #4212
